description: Defines the EntityAdapter class which wraps Drupal entity objects to provide Typed Data API functionality, including property access, conversion to array, and iteration.

classes.name: EntityAdapter
classes.description: Wraps Drupal entity objects to provide Typed Data API functionality, including property management, array conversion, iteration, and change notification.

methods.name: createFromEntity
methods.description: Creates an EntityAdapter instance wrapping the given entity.

methods.name: setValue
methods.description: Sets the wrapped entity object and optionally notifies parent of changes.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a property value from the entity.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets a property value on the entity.

methods.name: getProperties
methods.description: Returns the entity's properties, including computed if specified.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Converts the entity to an array.

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Checks if the wrapped entity is set.

methods.name: onChange
methods.description: Notifies the entity of a property change.

methods.name: getString
methods.description: Returns a string label for the entity.

methods.name: applyDefaultValue
methods.description: Applies default values to all properties.

methods.name: getIterator
methods.description: Provides an iterator over the entity's data.
